ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 80% of the visible surface, contrasted against low-intensity black borders and mid-intensity brownish-ochre mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across both lobes. Dark pigmentation concentrated in a narrow band along the trailing edges. Brownish-ochre vertical streaks and irregular blotches localized in the mid-to-lower regions of both lobes, with several small dark focal points distributed across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35-40 degrees at the central junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the entire visible trailing edge. Right lobe exhibits high-amplitude indentations and peaks, particularly near the distal end. Left lobe shows moderate serration with a jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the peduncle, sweeping upwards and outwards with a steepening gradient toward the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (potential scarring or barnacle attachment sites) visible across the medial-distal region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark linear disruptions and vertical brownish streaks visible on the white ventral surface, primarily on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive, irregular tissue loss and extremely ragged margins along the trailing edge of the right lobe, consistent with significant physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical brownish-yellow pigmentation streaks (likely diatom film) distributed across the central portion of the fluke surface.
